citation: Liu et al. (2026) A multimodal perturbation atlas defines the phenotypic resolution of cellular morphology
description: A multimodal CRISPR perturbation atlas of 1,000 gene knockouts in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells, profiling each perturbation across three orthogonal readouts: 1) high-content fluorescence imaging (39 live-cell + 13 fixed-cell markers spanning organelles and signaling pathways), 2) label-free quantitative phase imaging of the same cells (totaling ~58M cells), and 3) single-cell transcriptomes via CROP-seq (~600k cells).
title: Altair - A549 1k
